_about: The most JS+CSS (same-origin, raw bytes) each page may fetch on its first load, before a project exists. Judged by npm run verify. Each row was captured at 110% of what loaded at the time; tighten a row by editing it, recapture every row with `npm run verify -- --budget` (a deliberate act, like --baseline, and worth a sentence in the commit). The lazy chunks — supabase-*, pptxgen-*, sample.dragon.script-* — are failed by name if a first paint ever fetches one, whatever the total says.

admin.why: Raised deliberately 9 Oct 2026, this ROW ONLY, not a --budget recapture. Two causes, both intended. (1) The admin console gained the Trial and Price-rise blocks (schema 30). (2) gate-ui.js now imports startInviteLink, so every app page fetches the small `startlib` chunk — 2.6 KB here, and admin was the only page close enough to its ceiling to tip. That chunk exists because start.html was statically importing a 209 KB app bundle to send one counter; +2.6 KB on an internal page buys -206 KB on the public landing page. The alternative was duplicating CODE_PASS_KEY — a storage key — into start.js, which invariant 1 forbids.
